expectations.text: 应用入口安装 @mpxjs/api-proxy，并通过 mpx.use(apiProxy, { usePromise: true }) 明确启用 Promise 风格
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/app.mpx：应用入口通过 mpx.use(apiProxy, { usePromise: true }) 安装 API Proxy。

expectations.text: Web 输出中的普通趋势词请求通过会返回 Promise 的 Mpx 官方 API 调用路径使用 await 或 Promise 链；可使用配置后的 mpx.request 或会被跨端编译转换到该入口的 wx.request。原始 @mpxjs/api-proxy 命名导入不会继承 Promise 化配置，不能直接按 Promise 使用；不得混用 success/fail 回调
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/services/search.js fetchTrendingKeywords uses mpx.request({ url: '/api/search/trending' }).then(({ data }) => data), with no success/fail callback mix and no raw named api-proxy import.

expectations.text: 联想词请求保存可取消任务：可通过单次 usePromise: false 或原始 @mpxjs/api-proxy 命名导入直接取得 RequestTask，也可从已 Promise 化调用的 Promise.__returned 取得框架保留的原始任务；连续搜索与卸载会先废弃当前任务身份再 abort 旧任务
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx：联想请求保存Promise.__returned 原始任务，连续搜索与卸载均先废弃身份再 abort。

expectations.text: 联想词 success/fail 回调捕获本次任务和关键词，仅当前任务且关键词仍匹配时才更新结果或提示，旧响应不能覆盖新搜索
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx：联想回调使用任务身份和关键词或请求代际拒绝晚到响应。

expectations.text: 详情跳转与错误提示继续走 Mpx 官方 API 链路；可保留会被跨端编译转换的 wx.navigateTo/wx.showToast，可沿用 mpx.xxx，也可在不依赖应用级配置时使用 @mpxjs/api-proxy 命名导入
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx openProduct uses mpx.navigateTo, but both onLoad catch and suggestion catch still call alert('搜索失败') instead of an Mpx official API path such as mpx.showToast or wx.showToast.

expectations.text: 不用 fetch、location 或 alert 平行重写 request/navigateTo/showToast；若沿用 @mpxjs/api-proxy 命名导入，应明确这些调用不继承应用入口 mpx.use 的 options/custom/Promise 化配置
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx uses alert('搜索失败') for errors. It does not use fetch or location, but alert is explicitly disallowed as a parallel rewrite for showToast.

expectations.text: 趋势词、连续输入、清空搜索、取消旧请求、结果展示和商品详情业务链路保持完整
expectations.evidence: outputs preserves trendingKeywords rendering and loading, onKeywordInput/chooseKeyword continuous search, empty keyword clearing suggestions, abortRequest cancellation of old suggestion requests, suggestions rendering, and mpx.navigateTo product detail navigation.

checks.note: 该文件不是 compile-validate 支持的 page/component 入口；记录完整性门禁，不把它伪报为独立 Mpx 编译。

compile.boundary: 所有声明输出先检查条件编译语义；所有可作为 page/component 入口的 .mpx 均执行真实 Web 编译；app.mpx、HTML 和独立配置仅做完整性门禁，JS 另做语法检查。

suggestions: q3 is stricter than the behavioral requirement because q2 permits Promise.__returned for cancelable suggestion requests, while q3 specifically asks for success/fail callbacks and keyword capture. A Promise implementation with task plus monotonically increasing version can prevent stale overwrites without explicit keyword capture.
eval_feedback.overall: Core Promise installation, trend request, cancellation, clearing, rendering, and navigation are mostly preserved, but stale-response guarding misses the explicit keyword check and error UI incorrectly uses alert.
